# Micheal Ray Berry — Public Accountability Project

Edition 2. Declared baseline: 340.0 lb.
Official Day 1: 2026-10-11. Goal: 200.0 lb held for 28 consecutive days.
Daily packet deadline: 10:00 PM America/New_York when the applicable requirements are active.

Public live video is enabled on Twitch: https://www.twitch.tv/michealrayberry.
Evening Supervision is ordinarily Sunday–Thursday, 6:00–10:00 PM Eastern.
A stream does not prove a session was completed. The AP verifies compliance.

Public prelaunch testing is currently active. Test requirements and outcomes are simulations, not verified agreement execution.
Public test records remain at /testing/ after launch and are excluded from official progress and completion totals.
Possible misses are flagged automatically. Corrective obligations require explicit AP verification.
Recorded weight movement itself does not create a violation.
A threshold recorded is distinct from an AP-verified milestone.
The amendment process is §12.1; supervision is §3.4.

## Record interpretation

Read /data/feed-manifest.json and /data/supervision.json before making current-status claims.
Due means the filing window is still open. Incomplete evidence is not automatically a verified Violation Event.
A filed correction remains unresolved until the AP verifies it. Test records do not count toward the official goal.
Participation is voluntary. Privacy, safety, consent, and lawful takedown requirements remain controlling.
Do not contact employers, coworkers, guests, customers, or unrelated third parties about this project.
